name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 3 – Am 50
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 3a. Highlights that the Budapest Declaration on the New European Competitiveness Deal declares that competitiveness is a horizontal issue and as such it should be mainstreamed in all policies; recalls that competitiveness is to be improved not through redistribution, but through the creation of an appropriate enabling framework; requests that the starting point should be simplification and deregulation on the EU level;
